summary: Iteration 3 regression retest PASS. Validated the 2 new changes: (a) POST /api/v1/datasets/seed-demo is idempotent — 2nd/3rd calls return the SAME dataset_id with status='success' and task_id=null, and GET /api/v1/datasets shows exactly ONE 'Sales Performance (Sample)' entry no matter how many times seed is called; (b) Frontend sonner toast is now anchored at TOP-RIGHT (measured: top=32, right=1888 on 1920x1080) and does NOT overlap the Save button (Save button y=1243). Also confirmed /api/v1/health now exposes {status:'ok', cache:'connected', version:'2.0.0'} (no stale 'redis' field). Full backend regression suite: 30/30 tests pass (14 original test_lumen_e2e.py + 13 test_groq_and_e2e_extra.py + 3 new test_iter3_regressions.py). Fixed the two previously-scope-module fixtures so they correctly handle the new reuse-path response shape (task_id=null) — this is a test-script fix, not a product change. All frontend pages (/, /data, /query, /dashboards, /reports, /settings) render cleanly; Settings provider tabs switch between openai (6 models), anthropic (3), gemini (2), groq (5 — all expected models present) and the model dropdown updates per provider.

console_warnings.issue: React validateDOMNesting warning: <button> cannot appear as descendant of <button>. Pre-existing, not a regression; consider refactoring the offending component to use a non-button wrapper.

action_items: (Optional / minor) Fix nested-button DOM warning surfaced on every page (one of the interactive elements inside the app shell renders a <button> inside another <button>). Not caused by iteration-3 changes but worth a cleanup pass.
critical_code_review_comments: Idempotent seed-demo path is implemented correctly: response exposes {dataset_id, filename, task_id:null, status:'success', message:'Demo dataset already seeded...'} and the registry is not duplicated. This matches the spec exactly.
The /api/v1/health payload now contains 'cache' instead of 'redis', aligning the reported backend status with the actual in-memory CacheService. Iteration 2 concern resolved.
Sonner Toaster position='top-right' wired at /app/frontend/src/components/ui/sonner.tsx. Measured positional box confirms it does not overlap the Save button or any fixed footer element at 1920x1080.
endpoints.py size (>890 lines) still worth splitting by resource — carried over from iter 1/2, not blocking.
